_comment: Source-of-truth list of photographs used on the site.
`src`   original camera file under images/ (never edited, never served)
`note`  what the photo shows, so the next person picks the right one
`hero`  also render an 1800px derivative for full-bleed / large use
Run `python tools/optimize-images.py` after editing this file. It writes
EXIF rotation baked in and metadata stripped. Originals are left alone.
Near-duplicate frames from the same burst are deliberately left out — see
tools/README.md for the ones that were skipped and why.
